# OpsTools

Free business document tools for Indian small businesses.

## Tools
- [Fuel Bill Generator](https://www.opstools.ai/documents/fuel-bill)
- [Rent Receipt Generator](https://www.opstools.ai/documents/rent-receipt)
- [GST Invoice Generator](https://www.opstools.ai/documents/gst-invoice)
- [Salary Slip Generator](https://www.opstools.ai/documents/salary-slip)
- [L&D Bill Generator](https://www.opstools.ai/documents/ld-bill)
- [ROI Calculator](https://www.opstools.ai/business/roi-calculator)
